title: Hue wheel
description: Explore a color continuously with direct manipulation and an exact keyboard value.
useCase: Explore a color continuously with direct manipulation and an exact keyboard value.
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: HSL hue control with fixed saturation and lightness; this is not a perceptually uniform or full-gamut color picker.
look: Lavender-grey page with a white rounded card: a pastel rainbow ring around a solid colour disc, a monospace degree readout and six round swatches.
motion: Dragging around the ring rotates the white thumb to the pointer's angle and recolours the centre disc instantly; swatches jump the hue, and arrow keys step one degree.
adapt: `update` converts the pointer angle (`Math.atan2`) into `hue`, which rotates `wheel-thumb` and fills `wheel-center` with `color` (fixed 44% saturation, 64% lightness); the ring is a CSS `conic-gradient`. Replace the swatch hues with your palette and add saturation or lightness controls if needed.
